headline: South Korea raises interest rates to 3.25 percent amid massive AI chip boom
label: NEWS
caption:
South Korea's central bank has raised interest rates as red hot chip demand drives rapid economic growth 📈

The Bank of Korea raised its key rate by 0.25 percent to 3.25 percent on Thursday, citing strong domestic growth and above target inflation according to Al Jazeera.

The central bank stated that the global economy is expected to maintain a favourable growth trend due to robust AI investment despite tensions in the Middle East.

South Korea exports rose 94 percent year on year in October to reach 115.3 billion dollars, with semiconductors accounting for nearly half of total exports.
